participant_1.name: Amina
participant_1.personality: Expressive and enthusiastic about dance, Amina enjoys sharing her passion with others.
participant_1.background: My aunt helped me escape when I was young. I like to dance. Now I live in the United States. I was born in Somalia.

participant_2.name: Jake
participant_2.personality: Caring and supportive, Jake is a team player who enjoys conversations about interests like dancing and sports.
participant_2.background: I work in the insurance business. My father is in the army. I love playing softball. I recently was fired and had to get a new job.
